summary: Anthropic-affiliated researchers report that lie detectors fine-tuned on on-policy lies from open-weight models generalize poorly out-of-distribution, with zero-shot prompting of larger models often outperforming them, and release the datasets used.

practices.reason: Finding that larger prompted models often beat fine-tuned detectors suggests zero-shot prompting may be a viable lie-detection baseline worth monitoring rather than adopting outright.
practices.quote: Zero-shot prompting of larger models often outperformed fine-tuned detectors entirely.
